_comment: Two independent trees. (1) years -> semesters -> subjects -> items: a subject is a folder (e.g. assets/guides/year-1/sem-1/cc104/); subject shape {id, code, title, items: []}. Each item is one of three kinds: {id, kind:"week", label, order, week, html?, pdf?} (numbered week), {id, kind:"special", label, order, html?, pdf?} (freeform entry like a Midterm Reviewer), or {id, kind:"note", label, order, text} (markdown text stored inline, no file at all). html/pdf are paths relative to this file; a week/special item needs at least one of them, a note needs `text` instead and never has html/pdf. (2) references -> items: general material not tied to any year/semester/subject (e.g. assets/references/web-development/); category shape {id, label, items: []}, each item {id, title, order, kind:"doc"|"note", html?/pdf?, or text? for kind:"note"} — same doc-vs-note split as subject items, just without the week/special distinction. Both trees start empty — publish from /admin.html and entries land here automatically. order controls sidebar/library sort order in both trees. Nothing in script.js needs to change when subjects, items, or reference categories are added — manual editing works too.
